title: Banana Oatmeal Recipe for Breakfast, Caramelized Banana Oats Recipe
title_hi: केला ओटमील रेसिपी ब्रेकफास्ट के लिए, केरामाइज्ड केले ओट्स रेसिपी
content:
Recently I have been having oatmeal in my breakfast a lot. I try to add some fruits into the oatmeal and make it more tasty and enjoyable. This is one recipe that I made yesterday and loved it, so with no more delay I am sharing it.

I used some ripe bananas and for sweetener, I used jaggery in this. You can add brown sugar or honey for sweetener. Stay tuned I will be sharing much more oatmeal recipes soon.

 

Preparation Time: 5 mins

Cooking Time: 10 mins

Serves: 2

 

Ingredients:

Regular Milk or Soy Milk – 2 cup

Instant Quick Cooking Oats – 1/2 cup

Cinnamon – 1/2 tsp

Brown Sugar or Jaggery – 1 tablespoon or to taste

 

For Topping:

Ripe Banana – 1 sliced

Brown Sugar / Jaggery – 1 tablespoon

Butter – 1 tsp

 

Method:

 

Start by making the caramel. Heat butter in a pan, add in sliced bananas and brown sugar and saute till for 3 to 4 mins till caramelized. Remove this to a bowl and set aside.

Now in the same pan, add in oats, soy milk, cinnamon, and brown sugar and mix well. Cook till oats are done. 

Now spoon this into a bowl and top with bananas. Serve.
content_hi:
हाल ही में मैं अपने नाश्ते में दलिया बहुत कुछ कर रहा हूं। मैं दलिया में कुछ फल जोड़ने और इसे और अधिक स्वादिष्ट और सुखद बनाने की कोशिश करता हूं। यह एक नुस्खा है जो मैंने कल बनाया था और इसे प्यार करता था, इसलिए अधिक देरी के साथ मैं इसे साझा नहीं कर रहा हूं।

मैंने कुछ पके हुए केले का इस्तेमाल किया और स्वीटनर के लिए, मैंने इसमें गुड़ का इस्तेमाल किया। आप स्वीटनर के लिए ब्राउन शुगर या शहद मिला सकते हैं। बने रहें मैं जल्द ही बहुत अधिक दलिया व्यंजनों को साझा करूंगा।

 

तैयारी का समय: 5 मिनट

खाना पकाने का समय: 10 मिनट

सर्व: २

 

सामग्री:

नियमित दूध या सोया दूध - 2 कप

इंस्टेंट क्विक कुकिंग ओट्स - 1/2 कप

दालचीनी - 1/2 चम्मच

ब्राउन शुगर या गुड़ - 1 बड़ा चम्मच या स्वाद के लिए

 

टॉपिंग के लिए:

पका हुआ केला - 1 कटा हुआ

ब्राउन शुगर / गुड़ - 1 बड़ा चम्मच

मक्खन - 1 चम्मच

 

तरीका:

 

कारमेल बनाकर शुरू करें। एक पैन में मक्खन गरम करें, कटा हुआ केला और ब्राउन शुगर में डालें और कारमेलाइज्ड होने तक 3 से 4 मिनट तक तले। इसे एक कटोरे में निकालें और एक तरफ सेट करें।

अब उसी पैन में ओट्स, सोया मिल्क, दालचीनी, और ब्राउन शुगर डालें और अच्छी तरह मिलाएँ। जई होने तक पकाएं।

अब इसे एक कटोरी में चम्मच और केले के साथ शीर्ष। सेवा कर।

related.title: Tasty Oven Roasted Chicken ( With Vegetables ) Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी ओवेन रोस्टेड चिकन (सब्जियों के साथ) रेसिपी
related.content:
Delicious and very easy roast chicken with veggies tastes so yummy. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Healthy chicken with veggies.

This is an easy dinner or lunch to put together. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Once you assembled everything it takes around 40 to 45 mins to cook. The chicken is so flavourful and tastes so juicy. The chicken outside has a nice crust in them and the inside is so juicy.

 

Roast Chicken with Vegetables

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 5 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 whole chicken, cut into 12 pieces

Oil - 3 tablespoons

Carrot - 2 chopped

Cauliflower - 2 cups

Onion - 1 chopped

Potato - 1 peeled and cubed

Garlic - 10 cloves with skins on

 

FOR SPICE MIX:

Red Chilli Flakes - 1 tablespoon

Chilli Powder or Paprika - 1 tablespoon

Salt - 1 tablespoon

Parsley - 2 tablespoons

Oregano - 1 tablespoon

Sumac - 2 tablespoons

 

Instructions

Preheat oven to 200 degrees C. Mix spice mix together and set aside.

Take veggies in a baking pan. Add spice mix and oil and toss well.

Place chicken over it and sprinkle with spice mix and oil and mix well.

Pop it in the oven and bake for 35 to 45 mins.

Remove and serve it.

related.title: Tasty Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe
related.content:
Delicious spicy chicken curry made using roasted spice masala and coconut masala which is so yummy with rice.

This chicken curry is made using roasted whole spices masala which tastes super delicious. The freshly roasted spices give so much flavor to the chicken curry and make it super yummy.

 

Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 15 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 1 hour

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 6 serving

 

Ingredients

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Fennel seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 2 teaspoons

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam - 1 teaspoon

Bay Leaf - 1

Cardamom / Yelakai - 5

Cloves / Krambu - 5

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Brinji Ilai / Pandan Leaf - 1

Chicken - 1 kg

Shallots - 30 peeled and chopped finely

Tomato - 4 to 5 chopped finely

Green Chillies - 2 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Potato - 1 peeled and cubed

Salt to taste

Tomato - 1 chopped for adding last

Curry Leaves a handful for adding last

 

TO ROAST & GRIND:

Dry Red Chilli - 10 to 12

Coriander Leaves - 4 tablespoons

Cumin Seeds - 2 teaspoons

Black Pepper - 2 teaspoons

Curry leaves a handful

TO GRIND:

Coconut - 1 cup grated

Roasted Gram Dal / Pori Kadalai - 1 teaspoon

Fennel Seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 1 teaspoon

 

Instructions

Heat a pan, add whole spices to toast. Cook till golden. Take it in a blender and puree till smooth. Set aside.

Take coconut, gram dal, fennel and grind to a smooth paste.

Now heat oil in a pan, add in whole spices, onions and cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and saute till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and curry leaves and mix well.

Add in chicken and cook till 5 to 6 mins.

Add in roasted coconut masala and water. Mix well.

Add this in a pressure cooker and cook for 2 whistles.

Take it off the heat and open the cooker.

Add in potatoes and cook till it is done.

Add in coconut masala and simmer for 10 to 15 mins.

Take the curry off the heat and add in tomato and curry leaves.

Serve it.

related.title: Tasty Pepper Chicken ( Milagu )  Gravy Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी काली मिर्च चिकन (मिलगु) ग्रेवी रेसिपी
related.content:
Spicy black pepper chicken gravy goes well with roti, rice or idli or dosa too. This spicy chicken curry tastes super delicious and very peppery.

I have shared a few varieties of pepper chicken and mutton recipes here. But I haven’t shared the pepper chicken gravy which we simply love. I make this all the time. So here it is. It is not at all hard to make, it is super easy to make and taste simply amazing.

 

Pepper Chicken Gravy Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 500 grams

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Bay Leaf - 1

Onion - 2 large sliced thinly

Green Chilli - 2 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Tomatoes - 2 large chopped finely

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chilli powder - 2 teaspoons

Garam Masala Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Coriander Leaves for garnishing

 

FOR ROASTING & GRINDING:

Oil - 1 tsp

Fennel Seeds / Saunf / Sombu - 1 tablespoon

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Black Pepper - 1 tablespoon

Coriander Seeds - 2 tablespoons

Onion - 1 large chopped

 

Instructions

Pressure cook chicken with a little salt for 2 to 3 whistles. Set aside.

Heat little oil in a pot. Add in spices and toast them. Take it in a blender.

Add onions and cook till golden brown. Add it with the spices and grind till smooth. Set aside.

Heat oil in a pot, add in onions, chilies and bay leaf. Cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and cook till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Add in the ground masala and mix well.

Add salt, turmeric powder, chili powder, and garam masala and cook till oil separates.

Now add in the chicken along with any cooking liquid.

Mix well and simmer till oil separates.

Add coriander leaves and mix well.

Serve it.

related.title: Tasty Cheesy Chicken Nuggets ( Kids Special ) Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी चीज चिकन नगेट्स (किड्स स्पेशल) रेसिपी
related.content:
Cheesy chicken nuggets will be your kid's new favorite snack. So delicious and these are pan-fried instead of deep frying so it is more healthy.

This is so easy to make, you can make a bunch of these and freeze them. So you can fry them whenever you need them. Many of my readers have been asking for toddler nuggets recipe. I made this for my little one and she loved it to the core.

 

Cheesy Chicken Nuggets Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Snacks

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken Breast - 2 cut into strips

Oil for pan-frying

 

FOR CRISPY COATING:

Breadcrumbs - 1 cup

Cheese - ¼ cup grated

Dried Parsley - 1 teaspoon

Garlic Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

FOR BATTER:

Cornflour - 2 tablespoons

All-Purpose Flour - 4 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients for crispy coating and set aside.

Take all ingredients for batter and mix well.

Take the chicken and dip in the batter, coat in breadcrumbs.

Now pan fry till golden brown on each side.

Serve with ketchup.
